desc:
🍛 Welcome to the Nasi Padang Shop!

Open your very own Nasi Padang shop at the Salero Kampuang Culinary District roadside. Shop for ingredients, cook dishes, stock your display case, and serve the steady stream of customers!

🔥 Cook rendang, *ayam pop*, *gulai*, *dendeng balado*, and more
🛒 Buy ingredients and cooking tools at the grocery store
🪑 Customers can dine in or get takeout
🛵 Accept online orders from the GoPud delivery driver
👥 Hire staff to help run your shop
🏠 Open an outdoor seating area and build a second floor
⭐ Aim for a 5-star rating and become the best-selling shop
😂 Watch out for hilarious customers who might suddenly start dancing!
🐱 Don't forget to pet Onde Mande the Cat

Play solo or invite friends—there are 6 shops per server. You can even visit and eat at other players' shops!

One extra serving of rice, please! 👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite so you don't miss any updates.
